title: {witness} clocks it
opening: You come in and {crush} lights up before {crush.they} can stop it. {witness} sees the whole thing from the end of the bar.

pages.speaker: @witness
pages.text: So. You and {crush}. Don't make that face, {crush.they} did the exact same one.

pages.speaker: @crush
pages.text: Ignore {witness.them}. {Witness.they} gets bored on quiet nights.

choices.label: Own it
choices.result: You don't deny it. {crush} goes pink and pretends to wipe the same glass three times. {witness} raises {witness.their} drink to you both.

fail.result: You open your mouth to say it and order a lemonade instead. {witness} will never let this go. {crush} looks, if anything, charmed.

choices.label: Turn it back on {witness}
choices.result: "Funny, I was going to ask you the same thing." {witness} chokes on {witness.their} drink. {crush} laughs and slides you one on the house.
